facts.fact: A Reroll cut short at `replaying` (or an unknown phase) is told to the GMs with the character, the action, and the first and new totals.
The undo may have run in part; the GMs are told to check what the action leaves and settle it by hand.
The Hope stays paid, and the GMs' bookmark of that roll is dropped, so it cannot be rerolled again.

en.before: {name}'s Reroll ({action}) was cut short by a reload while its action was being taken back and made again. The first roll was {first}, the new one {total}; the card shows the new one. What the first roll did may be undone only in part: check by hand what this action leaves - progress, items, Remnants, damage, a turn - and settle it. The Hope stays paid, and this roll cannot be rerolled again.
en.after: A reload cut {name}'s Reroll ({action}) short while its action was being taken back and replayed. The card shows the new total, {total}; the first was {first}. The first roll's effects may be only partly undone, so check its progress, items, Remnants, damage, and turn, and settle them by hand. The Hope stays paid, and this roll cannot be rerolled.

pl.before: Reroll postaci {name} ({action}) przerwało przeładowanie w chwili, gdy jej akcja była cofana i wykonywana ponownie. Pierwszy rzut dał {first}, nowy {total}; karta pokazuje nowy. To, co zrobił pierwszy rzut, mogło zostać cofnięte tylko częściowo: sprawdź ręcznie, co zostawia ta akcja - postęp, przedmioty, Remnanty, obrażenia, turę - i rozstrzygnij to. Hope zostaje zapłacony, a na tym rzucie nie da się już zrobić Rerolla.
pl.after: Przeładowanie przerwało Reroll postaci {name} ({action}), gdy jej akcja była cofana i wykonywana ponownie. Pierwszy rzut dał {first}, nowy {total}, a karta pokazuje nowy. To, co zrobił pierwszy rzut, mogło zostać cofnięte tylko częściowo, więc sprawdź i popraw ręcznie postęp, przedmioty, Remnanty, obrażenia i turę. Hope pozostaje wydany, a na tym rzucie nie da się już zrobić Rerolla.

"nobody can reroll this roll again" reads clumsily (reroll ... roll ... again); the passive here hides no reader. "which the card shows" can be read as pointing at both totals. (proposed: "A reload cut {name}'s Reroll ({action}) short while its action was being taken back and replayed. The first roll was {first} and the new one {total}; the card shows the new one. The Hope stays paid, and this roll can no longer be rerolled.") - executor: Taken in part: “and settle them by hand” (fact 1, O7) and the totals told apart, as proposed; the proposal came to 67 words of the GM card's 60, so the totals are one clause (“The card shows the new total, {total}; the first was {first}.”) and the last sentence “this roll can't be rerolled” - 60 words.

Fakt 1: GM ma sprawdzić i rozstrzygnąć ręcznie; „sprawdź ręcznie” po polsku nie mówi, że trzeba też poprawić. Dwa słowa więcej, 58 z limitu 60. (proposed: "Przeładowanie przerwało Reroll postaci {name} ({action}), gdy jej akcja była cofana i wykonywana ponownie. Pierwszy rzut dał {first}, nowy {total}, a karta pokazuje nowy. To, co zrobił pierwszy rzut, mogło zostać cofnięte tylko częściowo, więc sprawdź i popraw ręcznie postęp, przedmioty, Remnanty, obrażenia i turę. Hope zostaje zapłacony, a na tym rzucie nie da się już zrobić Rerolla.") - executor: Taken; „Hope pozostaje wydany” jak w interruptedPending (O14).

en.after: {name}'s Reroll did not finish. The GM will settle it, and the Hope stays paid.

pl.before: Reroll postaci {name} przerwało przeładowanie w trakcie. Rozstrzygnie go GM; Hope zostaje zapłacony.
pl.after: Reroll postaci {name} nie dobiegł końca. Rozstrzygnie go GM, a Hope pozostaje wydany.

en.after: {name}'s Reroll did not finish. The first roll stands, and the GM will check the Hope.

facts.fact: When the bridge's clock runs out on the Reroll's request, the asker is told it may still be made; a late answer posts the card, a late refusal is said then.
The player's browser pays nothing; the GM pays only when it makes the Reroll.

en.after: Your Reroll is still waiting. If it goes through, its card follows; if not, you keep your Hope.

pl.before: GM nie odpowiedział na czas w sprawie Rerolla, ale Reroll może jeszcze zostać wykonany: jeśli tak, przyjdzie jego karta; jeśli nie, Hope nie przepada.
pl.after: Twój Reroll jeszcze czeka. Jeśli dojdzie do skutku, przyjdzie jego karta; jeśli nie, Hope zostaje przy tobie.

Shorter, to the toast's target (T4).

points: „jeszcze czeka” bez dopełnienia jest zrozumiałe; „czeka jeszcze na GM-a” byłoby pełniejsze, ale fakty nie wymagają.

facts.fact: A card a Reroll replaced gets its total struck through and one line with the old and new total, drawn for whoever reads that card.
The Reroll's own card is whispered to the character's owner and the GMs only.

en.after: Rerolled: {from} -> {to}.

pl.after: Po Rerollu: {from} -> {to}.

facts.fact: Of the clean-up actions only Erase a Trace and Reshape a Trace are replayed; a Misleading Trail and a Move the Body keep what they did, and the card says this line.

en.after: The dice are new, but what your clean-up did stays: a Reroll does not take back a Misleading Trail or a moved body. Ask the GM if it should be undone.

pl.before: Kości przepisano, ale podłożony Remnant już leży w pokoju - Reroll go nie podniesie. Zapytaj GM-a, czy ma zniknąć.
pl.after: Kości są nowe, ale to, co zrobiło twoje sprzątanie, zostaje: Reroll nie cofa Misleading Trail ani Move the Body. Zapytaj GM-a, czy to cofnąć.

"what you planted is already lying in the room": the line also stands for a moved body, so it names both.
disagreements: The text spoke only of something planted lying in the room; reroll.mjs settleCleanup shows it for every clean-up that is not an erase or a reshape, Move the Body included.

points: Remark: "Ask the GM whether it should be undone" reads slightly better than "if" here; not a rule.

facts.fact: A theft is never undone by a Reroll: one line, true whether the theft worked or not, and nothing else changes.
The line goes into the Reroll's Hope Call card, whispered to the character's owner and the GMs (postHopeCallCard, from askReroll's answer lines).

en.before: The dice are rewritten, but the moment is not. Your hand has already been in their pocket, and putting something back is something they would watch you do.
en.after: The dice are new, but whatever your hand did in their pocket stands.

pl.before: Kości przepisano, ale chwila nie. Twoja ręka już była w cudzej kieszeni, a odkładanie czegoś z powrotem właściciel by zobaczył.
pl.after: Kości są nowe, ale to, co twoja ręka zrobiła w cudzej kieszeni, zostaje.

facts.fact: A forced Frisk's roll is in full view: its Reroll changes nothing and says this line.

en.after: The dice are new, but the moment stands: the whole room saw how it went.

pl.after: Kości są nowe, ale cały pokój już widział, jak poszło.

points: „chwila zostaje” - nikt tak nie mówi; to dosłowne odwrócenie „the moment stands”. Sens niesie sama druga część. (proposed: "Kości są nowe, ale cały pokój już widział, jak poszło.") - executor: Taken.

en.before: The dice are rewritten, but the moment is not. They already know whether you got a proper look.
en.after: The dice are new, but the moment stands: they felt your hand and already know whether you got a proper look.

facts.fact: An Erase a Trace or Reshape a Trace is replayed on the GM with undo: the erased Remnant is made again (a reshaped one put back), the Remnant a botched wipe left is removed, and what was paid is refunded before the new number is scored.

The line goes into the Reroll's Hope Call card, whispered to the character's owner and the GMs (postHopeCallCard, from askReroll's answer lines).

en.before: The clean-up is taken back and attempted again. The Remnant comes back, anything the botched wipe left is removed, and the Sanity is refunded first.
en.after: Your clean-up is taken back and tried again with the new roll. The Remnant returns as it was, any Remnant a botched first attempt left is removed, and you pay for one attempt only.

The Polish said the same wrong thing („to, co zostawiła nieudana próba”) and takes the condition too.

en.after: The room's Search Token stays spent, because the room was searched either way.

en.after: {name} breaks again, and its repair now needs {n} progress.

en.after: The critical is gone, so the Reroll takes back the action it gave you.

facts.fact: The intro at the top of the Note tab when the reader is not a GM looking at another user's note; a GM looking at a player's note reads DRPG.Note.gmIntro instead.
